Done. `artifact.html` is complete and verified.

**What was built** — a single self-contained 620 KB HTML file with zero external references (Three.js r128, MIT, inlined; all CSS/JS inline):

- **Model**: fuselage with cockpit glass bubble, tail boom, vertical fin + horizontal stabilizer, spinning 2-blade tail rotor, 4-blade main rotor with hub/mast plus a blur disc at high RPM, skids with struts, engine housing with exhausts
- **Physics**: engine spool-up to full RPM, collective lift vs. gravity, torque-induced uncommanded yaw at low collective, tilt-based thrust translation, drag, ground contact/settling, hover bobbing when lift ≈ gravity
- **Controls**: W/S pitch, A/D roll, Q/E yaw, Space/Shift collective, arrow keys trim (with preventDefault so the page doesn't scroll)
- **HUD**: altitude (AGL), speed (km/h), RPM % and throttle % readouts with animated bars; controls legend panel
- **Terrain**: heightfield terrain with a flat helipad (marked circle + ring), scattered trees/rocks for depth cues, fog, shadows

**Verification** — loaded headlessly in Chromium: no JS errors (only benign GPU-driver log noise), WebGL rendered, and pixel analysis of screenshots confirmed the helicopter is on screen and centered (white fuselage, dark rotor/skids, red fin all detected), with physics running (RPM spooling, position stable on the pad). Temp verification files were removed; only `artifact.html` remains modified.

One note: mid-task the file was overwritten by an external process with a CDN-dependent version; I detected this, rebuilt the fully self-contained version, and re-verified it.
